issues.summary: The filled primary renders about #0469F1, brighter than the accent token #0F72DB (image-generator colour drift; the build takes the token).
issues.quote: - **Colour.** System neutrals for surfaces and text; the brand blue, named only by its token `accent` (never a hex: white on the old literal fails 4.5:1), only on the one filled primary per region; no blue borders, links, icons or labels. Links are underlined neutral text. Snapmark's `info` is neutral: the chosen tab, the current page and "is" chips use a neutral mark, never blue. Keyboard focus shows the `focus` ring only on keyboard focus (WEB-9, a proposed web exception to ACC-2; see interaction.md). Remove red stays the picker outline and remove marks only.
